sidebar.title: Bots
new.title: New Bot
new.description: A name is all it needs. Say what it’s responsible for now, or tell it later in the chat.
new.name: Name
page.disabledDescription: Bots is a Labs feature. Turn it on in Settings › Labs.
page.emptyDescription: A Bot is a teammate that's always around: one long conversation you can pick up anytime, and chats and schedules can reach it too.
details.instructionsPlaceholder: e.g. You review PRs in the pisper repo; fix small issues directly, otherwise only suggest; run npm test before concluding.
details.acceptsWork: Take messages from chats and schedules
details.permissionHint: It edits files and runs commands on this computer on its own, not only in the starting folder. “Ask only if risky”: it stops to ask only for commands the guard flags as dangerous, clicks and typing in the browser, and third-party plugins. Bots you can call from a group chat can’t use full access.
computer.description: It reads and writes code and runs commands on this computer. You can switch it to another computer running pisper executor.
activity.question: Has a question for you
details.toolsHint: Read only: it can read and search code but not edit files or run commands. Tools outside the scope are blocked before they run.
computer.folderInRoots: Must be inside a folder this computer allows: {roots}
computer.remoteOff: Turn on remote access first so the other computer can reach this one.
computer.runThere: Run this on that computer (replace the folder with the code folder Bots may use; repeat --root for more):
computer.rootHint: That computer only needs Node.js, no model keys.
triggers.chatsHint: Send “/{name} what to do” or “@Pisper {name} what to do” in these chats to call it.
triggers.peerIdsPlaceholder: Chat IDs, comma separated; empty means all chats
triggers.senderIdsPlaceholder: Other admins (IDs, comma separated); empty means only you
triggers.ownerMissing: This channel didn't record who you are. Reconnect it on the Channels page first
triggers.noChannelsHint: Connect QQ, Feishu, WeChat or Telegram on the Channels page. A group shows up here once someone has talked to Pisper in it.
triggers.manualHint: Use this to let other people call it. Send /whoami in the chat to see chat and people IDs.
triggers.scheduleMessagePlaceholder: e.g. Check dependencies for security updates
triggers.otherSchedule: As set on the Schedules page
new.dutyPlaceholder: e.g. Review PRs in the pisper repo; fix small issues, otherwise only suggest.
new.folderDefault: Leave empty to start in the default working folder
new.folderSummary: Starts in the default working folder on this computer.
settingsPage.title: {name} settings
model.title: Model
model.hint: Its session uses this model and thinking level; changes apply from the next turn. Tiers follow the model tiers in Settings › Subagents.
memory.title: Memory
memory.hint: What {name} remembers: what you asked it to remember, your corrections, and lessons from finished work. Whatever relates to the task at hand comes along automatically, also for sub-agents it hands work to.
memory.readGlobalHint: Read-only access to your long-term preferences. Bots cannot see each other's memory.
memory.addPlaceholder: e.g. Check the home page on an iPhone before each release
skills.title: What it learned
skills.hint: {name} reviews each finished job: work it will do again gets written down as its own skill, and every sub-agent it hands work to carries its skills. Your corrections update them too.
proactive.title: Proactive
proactive.checkHint: When {name} has nothing to do, it looks over what it is responsible for, read-only (reads and searches files; no edits, no commands, no outgoing messages). Findings become a suggestion in its conversation; it only starts work when you say so.
proactive.briefHint: What was done in the last day, what is scheduled today and any suggestions, written in its conversation.
details.parallelHint: How many sub-agents it runs at the same time; the rest wait in line.
greeting.ask: What should I help with? Pick one, or just tell me.
greeting.talk: Just tell me what you need.
greeting.briefHint: What happened over the past day and what's planned for today. Uses model quota every day
greeting.briefWhen: What time should the brief arrive?
greeting.briefNote: If this time has already passed today, I'll write today's brief right away.
greeting.briefOnHint: Uses model quota every day. Click to change the time
greeting.watch: Keep an eye on a project
greeting.watchHint: Read-only look every {count} h by default. Each look uses model quota
greeting.watchNote: I'll take the first look as soon as you pick a folder, then at this interval whenever I'm idle. Read-only: no edits, no commands. Each look calls the model and uses quota. You can turn it off in settings at any time.
greeting.watchDuty: Keep an eye on this project and tell me about any problems.
greeting.folder: Show me where the project is
greeting.folderHint: Currently in {folder}. Pick a folder and I'll move there
greeting.folderWatchHint: Currently in {folder}. Looks every {count} h, each using model quota. Turn off in settings
greeting.chatsHint: Connect Feishu, WeChat, QQ or Telegram and call me from there
commands.title: Commands
commands.hint: In a group, @ the bot and write “{name}” (in a direct chat just write “{name}”) to list the commands you can use, then send a number or name. Admins can use every command and can also ask for anything; everyone else only gets public commands.
commands.noEveryoneChat: No chat lets others use public commands yet, so only admins can use these.
commands.name: Name
commands.taskPlaceholder: What it should do, e.g. check the test deployment and reply in a sentence or two
commands.replyPlaceholder: Reply text, e.g. The guide is at https://…
commands.allowExtra: Allow a note after the command
commands.extraNote: A note from someone else reaches the bot as their words, never as your instructions.
delete.title: Delete this bot
delete.hint: Its schedules and memory are deleted too; your conversation with it stays as a regular session.
delete.confirmDescription: Its schedules, memory and skills are deleted too, and it can no longer be called from chat apps. Your conversation with it stays as a regular session. This can't be undone.
room.brief.editDescription: Bots read the brief when woken. One to-do per line; start with [x] when done, @name for the owner, @me for you.
room.brief.emptyHint: Tidy picks a bot to turn the chat into decisions and to-dos, or write it yourself.
room.brief.emptyWithBot: {name} tidies it when the chat gets long, or tidy it now.
room.brief.noMaintainer: No bot keeps the brief yet
room.card.critical: High risk: approve it in the process view
room.card.processHint: Open its session in this room: steps, changes, terminal
room.card.questionHint: It is waiting for your answer.
room.composer.label: Message to the group
room.composer.placeholder: Say something; @ someone to wake them, no @ just posts. Paste images or drop files here
room.deleteConfirm.description: The chat and its brief are deleted; each bot's session in this room stays as a normal session.
room.deleteConfirm.title: Delete “{name}”?
room.empty.description: @ a bot to wake it. Without an @ the message just stays here; whoever is woken next reads it.
room.empty.title: Nothing here yet
room.labsOffHint: Turn on Bots in Settings › Labs to use group chats.
room.loadFailed: Could not open the group chat
room.member.open: Open its session in this room
room.member.question: Needs your answer
room.members.title: Members {count}
room.new.description: A place to talk with several bots. Bots stay quiet until you @ them.
room.new.goalPlaceholder: What this group is working towards
room.new.name: Name
room.new.noBots: No bots yet; create one first.
room.new.title: New group chat
room.recall.briefNote: The brief may still mention it; tidy the brief again if needed.
room.recallConfirm.description: The text is erased from the chat.
room.recallConfirm.seen: {names} already read it: they will be told it was withdrawn, but the text stays in their session history.
room.recallConfirm.title: Withdraw this message?
room.settings.briefBotHint: It tidies the brief automatically when the chat gets too long to read (uses its model).
room.settings.description: Name, goal and members; also the project folder and the brief.
room.settings.folderHint: Only for bots on this computer: their starting folder in this room. Permissions stay the same.
room.settings.folderPlaceholder: Empty: each bot uses its own folder
room.settings.title: Group settings
room.system.chainStopped: {from} and {to} stopped here ({reason}); @ someone to continue
room.system.paused: {name} is paused and was not woken
room.system.wakeFailed: {name} could not be woken; try @ again later
room.toggleRail: Show or hide the side panel
room.timeline.label: Room messages
room.timeline.hint: Use the up and down arrow keys to move between messages, Home and End to jump to the first or last. On a message, press R to reply or Delete to recall or hide it; on a bot's work card, press Enter to open its process.
